"""Pure text statistics, independent of input acquisition or process state."""

from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TextStats:
    """Immutable nonnegative integer counts of logical lines and words.

    Raises:
        TypeError: A field is not an integer count (including booleans).
        ValueError: A field is negative.
    """

    lines: int
    words: int

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for value in (self.lines, self.words):
            if not isinstance(value, int) or isinstance(value, bool):
                raise TypeError("counts must be integers")
            if value < 0:
                raise ValueError("counts must be nonnegative")


def count_text(text: str, *, strip_bom: bool = True) -> TextStats:
    """Count CRLF/CR/LF lines and Unicode-whitespace-separated words.

    Args:
        text: Caller-owned text; never changed.
        strip_bom: Remove exactly one leading U+FEFF before counting.

    Returns:
        Immutable statistics. Empty normalized text has zero lines; a final
        unterminated segment adds one line. Other Unicode separators affect
        words only. Retained BOMs are ordinary non-whitespace characters.

    This pure function emits no output and acquires no resources.
    """
    if strip_bom and text.startswith("\ufeff"):
        text = text[1:]
    # Subtract paired CRLFs so each pair contributes only one terminator.
    lines = text.count("\r") + text.count("\n") - text.count("\r\n")
    if text and not text.endswith(("\r", "\n")):
        lines += 1
    return TextStats(lines, len(text.split()))
